questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to the Crying Lady in Everbrook.
Find the cat north of the Mayor's House.
questProcedureLinks.note: The cat is described relative to Mayor's House, but the exact adjacent room is not modeled.

questProcedureLinks.text: Have a Milk Bucket to lure it back.
Return the cat to the Crying Lady.
Speak to Mary at the Cow Pen.
questProcedureLinks.note: Mary/Cow Pen is not a distinct structured room in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Pour a Water Bucket down the drain and collect the key from the mini-sewer.
Speak to Bob the Farmer after Mary says it is the wrong key.
Take the rusty key to the Sewer's Silkfang area and use the acid puddle.
Return the cleaned key to Mary.
questProcedureLinks.note: Mary/Cow Pen is not a distinct structured room in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to Minty in the starting-area house.
questProcedureLinks.note: Starting-area house is not modeled as a separate room.

questProcedureLinks.text: Put 1 Normal Log and 1 Coal Ore into the fireplace.
questProcedureLinks.note: Fireplace is inside the starting-area house, which is not separately modeled.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to the Chicken Farmer.
Kill 5 Chickens.
Speak to the Chicken Farmer again.
Speak to the Chef in Everbrook.
Deliver 5 Cooked Shrimp and 1 Bread.
Speak to the Crying Girl in Everbrook Cemetery.
Find the doll in the Sewer pipe directly above the water.
Return it to the Crying Girl.
Bring a Beanstalk Seed to Zapto in Mystic Vale.
Use the Water Shrine in Dock Haven to make it a Soaked Beanstalk Seed.
questProcedureLinks.note: v1.2 room model records the Water Orb altar at Dock Haven Dock.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return to Zapto.
During cloudy weather, use the soaked seed near the unusual clouds at the Everbrook Cow Farm.
Speak to the Sick Ent in Omboko.
Give the Paper-Maker a Piece of Paper to learn the Wooden Heart recipe.
Craft and return a Wooden Heart.
Wait for a global bonfire tick to make the heart Sacred.
questProcedureLinks.note: Global bonfire tick is not tied to a single room by the normalized quest text.

questProcedureLinks.text: Use Matches on the spawned bank torches.
questProcedureLinks.note: Omboko Bank is the local bank room in the world model; the quest text says bank torches.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to the first Brown Thief.
Bring a Bear Head.
Bring a Tiger Head.
Speak to the Mini Thief in Omboko and receive his picture.
Go to the Thieves Hideout and show the picture to the Mini Thief's father guarding the artifact room.
questProcedureLinks.note: The father's exact room is not separately identified in the current room model.

questProcedureLinks.text: Enter and defeat the Demon.
Take the artifact.
Return it to the Mini Thief in Omboko.
Speak to the Bully Thief on the second floor.
questProcedureLinks.note: Quest procedure says second floor while the v1.2 NPC record places Bully Thief in Thief Fat Guy; preserve the conflict.

questProcedureLinks.text: Bake/acquire a Cake and give it to him.
questProcedureLinks.note: Turn-in is to Bully Thief; current room placement conflicts with the procedure wording.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to Zapto in Mystic Vale.
Complete the mayor-approval sequence between Mystic Vale and Everbrook.
questProcedureLinks.note: Procedure describes a mayor-approval sequence between both towns.

questProcedureLinks.text: Deliver 500 Glass and 50 Iron Bars.
questProcedureLinks.note: Structured as the likely quest hand-in point because Zapto starts the sequence; retain as medium confidence.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to the Dwarf in the Mining Area; he asks for gemstones connected to Beach, Omboko, and Mystic Vale.
questProcedureLinks.note: The procedure calls this the Mining Area; v1.2 models Everbrook Mining Entrance.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to the Research Dwarf in each of the three regions, then report back to the Mining Dwarf.
questProcedureLinks.note: All three regions are known, but not every Research Dwarf is modeled with a verified room identity.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return to each Research Dwarf's room and dig as directed.
In Omboko, defeat the Tiger guarding the gemstone and obtain/mine the gemstone fragment.
In Mystic Vale, defeat the Red Mage guarding the gemstone and obtain/mine the gemstone fragment.
At the Beach, defeat the Crocodile guarding the gemstone and obtain/mine the gemstone fragment.
Return/complete the hand-in sequence with the Mining Dwarf to unlock the documented gemstone/mine rewards.
At Dock Haven, speak to the Watcher underneath the bank and accept the swim to Pirate Isle; unequip all gear before swimming.
questProcedureLinks.note: Procedure says underneath the bank; v1.2 currently places Watcher in Dock Haven Centre.

questProcedureLinks.text: On Pirate Isle, go south from the beach into the quicksand, speak to Marin, and agree to help.
Return to Dock Haven, take a Shovel from the bank, and give it to the Fishing Pirate in the room to the left.
questProcedureLinks.note: The bank/shovel part is linked; the Fishing Pirate's separate room is not modeled.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return to Pirate Isle, loot 1 Glass, then loot a Shovel one screen south.
questProcedureLinks.note: Infinite Glass is explicitly modeled on Pirate Beach; the shovel one screen south is not separately modeled.

questProcedureLinks.text: Use the Worship Dig Anywhere ability with the shovel to get Gunpowder; combine Gunpowder and Glass into a Vial of Gunpowder.
Use the Vial of Gunpowder on the broken board east of the pirates.
Follow the quest's explosive/tunnel sequence to open the route to Marin.
Reach Marin through the tunnel and help him escape.
Return to Dock Haven; speak to the Retired Pirate and then the Watcher to finish.
Speak to Volcanic Rocky near the lava pit in the Volcano.
Bring him a Cactus Log for testing.
Craft 100 Cactus Planks and deliver them; the test demonstrates that untreated planks burn.
Speak to the Everbrook Chef about oil coating.
Bring the Chef 100 Cactus Planks and Nethergrass from the Volcanic Rocky room so the planks can be coated.
questProcedureLinks.note: Step spans the Chef hand-in and Nethergrass source room.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return to the Volcano with Pyro Gloves, equip the gloves, and build the bridge.
Speak to Frostboot in Frostvale about the key to Mount Frostvale.
Speak to the Mayor for approval.
Fill the Mayor's log piles with 100 Oak Logs, 100 Mangrove Logs, and 100 Haunted Logs.
Bring the Mayor a Dragonfruit Pie of any quality.
Sign the Mayor's waiver.
Return to Frostboot, collect the key, and unlock the Mount Frostvale door.
Speak to the drunken pirate in the Jafa Tavern, then speak to the Pirate Ship Captain and accept the Desert Island voyage.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: On the boat, defeat the Stormy Clouds; after the boat is damaged, repair the three holes using 30 Mangrove Planks and 300 Nails.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: At the island, bank all gear and inventory before swimming ashore.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Follow the island survival route: defeat a Small Cloud, descend the ladder, take the Bronze Axe, defeat a beetle and take Bait.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Cut 43 Logs for the Bow, shafts, bridge repair, and a fire.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Loot Earth Orbs and a Pickaxe; mine the required Coal/Copper; restore Worship Points.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Kill Chickens for feathers, repair the bridge, collect a Fishing Rod, and kill Spiders for String.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Loot an Unpowered Orb and fish Sardines.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Sell one Earth Orb remotely, buy Matches, light a fire, cook/eat Sardines, then obtain the Fire Orb.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Smelt a Bronze Bar, forge Bronze Arrowheads, and craft Bronze Arrows.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Defeat Splashy and craft a Damage Orb 1.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Place the required orbs in the tombs, descend the ladder, take the shovel, then return and dig by the pirate.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Loot the map and chest and return them to the Jafa bar to complete the route.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Bring 3,500 Coins and 3 Beers to the Supplier's Store west of Jafa Outpost bank.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Pay 3,000 Coins for a Water Bucket and give it to the Dehydrated Ali outside.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Follow the Cousin dialogue to the Ali at the Everbrook Well, then return to the Supplier.
questProcedureLinks.note: Step includes the Ali at the Everbrook Well; v1.2 models a well at Everbrook Mining Entrance. Desert room coverage remains partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Use the beers to get the Supplier drunk, ask for a Water Bucket, and obtain the Temple door key he mistakenly gives you.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Enter the Desert Temple and progress through the statue, beetle, mirror, Angry Eye, and Black Statue rooms; collect keys from the relevant chests.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: In the water/fire room, use the levers to reveal the route; solve the later lever combination using the hanging-fire clue.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Solve the chest puzzle in order 2, 1, 3, 4 to obtain a key, and survive the multi-Angry-Eye section for another key.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Continue through the Black Statues and Zebeth route; locate the hidden researcher and recover the key near Zebeth's earlier position.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: At the keypad door enter 1988; attempt the lever and get sent to jail.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Pick your cell lock, pick the adjacent cell, and take the dead Ali's key.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Defeat 10 Poison Alis to continue; use the pickaxe wall shortcut if useful.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return through the researcher/water-patch route, reach the Supplier confrontation, defeat the Supplier, and pull the lever to complete the quest.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert internal-room model is intentionally partial.

questProcedureLinks.text: Complete the Desert Bundle to unlock the Waterfall Entrance.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Use the entrance and activate the lever that opens access to the researcher in the Desert Temple.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Speak to the researcher; he sends you to find a second researcher in a randomly selected Rogue Crypt.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Run Rogue Crypts until you find and speak to that researcher.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return to the first researcher; he tells you to dig deeper in the crypt.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Go to Crypt 4 (the room with four skeletons and a plant) and dig inside it to enter the deeper room.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Dig in front of the large purple cross to trigger a fight with three Deep Rogues at the same time; defeat all three.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Use the ladder that appears, interact with the statue, and collect three prisms.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return through the Desert Temple route and place the three prisms on the three statues.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.

questProcedureLinks.text: Return to the first researcher; follow him downstairs and speak to him again to complete the quest.
questProcedureLinks.note: Desert/Rogue Crypt internal-room model is not complete in v1.2.
